beats.care: If you haven't booked, compare government special buses and nearby dates. Last-minute flights could eat a month's rent.
beats.what: Fares from Chennai have shot up. Hyderabad went from Rs 4,467 to Rs 21,665, and Bengaluru from Rs 4,474 to Rs 18,041.
beats.why: Ayudha Pooja (Oct 19) and Vijayadashami (Oct 20) make a four-day break, and everyone is booking at the last minute.

cards.body: DT Next says the usual fare is around Rs 4,467, so it's nearly five times higher.

cards.q: Why do fares jump so much right before a long weekend?
cards.why: Airline prices change with demand and how many seats are left, so last-minute festive bookings cost the most.

cards.body: Mumbai went from Rs 6,469 to Rs 22,353. Coimbatore went from Rs 5,373 to Rs 16,601. Kochi is about Rs 18,255. Madurai rose less, to about Rs 8,500.
cards.title: Other routes

cards.body: Trains are mostly sold out too, News Today reports, and private bus fares are also rising.

hook: A Chennai–Hyderabad flight now costs *nearly five times* more. Why?

learn.t: Salem has no direct flight from Chennai, so flyers must connect via Bengaluru, now at about Rs 12,237.
